reporting-org.narrative: United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs

description.narrative: ltpgtThis project will distribute up to 12,000 non-food items (NFI) kits targeting some 60,000 individuals in 12 months in Sudan based on the actual needs and gaps in full coordination with the shelter and NFI cluster. The ongoing conflict since April 2023 has already uprooted 7.2 million internally and 2.2 million to neighbouring countries, with new displacement taking place daily. Combined with the pre-conflict IDP caseload Sudan has more than 10 million IDPs making it the largest internal displacement crisis in the world. In addition, about 220,000 refugees and asylum-seekers were secondarily displaced since the start of the conflict mostly from Khartoum to the refugee camps in White Nile State leading to overcrowding of the existing camps. There are an estimated 917,470 refugees and asylum-seekers in Sudan.lt/pgtltpgt ltbrgtStarting in May 2024 the conflict in Sudan escalated in El Fasher, North Darfur and has since moved into other states such as Sennar, leading to large-scale displacement with the respective states, but also into other states. The annual rainy season, starting in July, is predicted to be more severe and devastating than in previous years due to El Nino related climate effects and will likely affect large number of people. The displaced people will need life-saving NFIs such as sleeping mats, jerry cans, blankets, solar lamps, mosquito nets, plastic sheets and kitchen sets. These items help restore a minimal sense of dignity and protection against exposure to the elements, mitigate against health risks and provide some privacy and security to those in need. ltbrgtIn the event that UNHCR and/or its partners are unable to access prioritized areas and the most vulnerable, UNHCR in consultation with the SNFI Cluster shall endevour to distribute the pipeline to cluster partners who have access. lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtNFI is one of the top three priority needs expressed by the displaced population and will contributes to reduce the suffering of the displaced population. lt/pgtltpgtIn 2023, UNHCR reached over 560,000 people with the NFI assistance of which SHF funds for pre-positioned stocks accounted for the procurement and distribution of 9,000 kits in Gedaref, Blue Nile, Red Sea, Northern, Sennar, West Darfur, Central Darfur States. ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtThrough this allocation SHF funds will complement UNHCRs core funds which are allocated to the NFI pipeline within its capacity as Sector lead agency. ltbrgtlt/pgt
